messages:
alex: Heads up — prototyping a 'Save view' modal that shows estimated quota/cost impact per-route when you save a view that pins multiple models. Quick sanity check: are we comfortable surfacing per-route token estimates in the modal?
maya: The idea is useful — show expected tokens/day delta for the saved query. But sampling and selectivity will make numbers noisy. Need confidence UI.
sam: I worry about leaking traffic volumes if we show absolute token counts. Could we show relative change or bucketed ranges (<1%, 1-5%, 5%+)?
lee: Or gate absolutes behind a toggle: 'Show detailed estimates (requires telemetry access)'. Default to ranges for most users.
ops-bot: FYI telemetry note: sampling is 1% for free orgs and higher for paid tiers; estimates will be low-confidence for small orgs.
alex: UX thought: show estimate + confidence bar. Confidence = function(recent_sample_rate, request_count, filter_selectivity). If confidence low, display range and a tiny tool-tip explaining sampling.
maya: Implementation detail: we need an API endpoint. Something like POST /v1/console/estimate_saved_view that accepts route_id, model_pins, filters, lookback_days and returns tokens_delta, cost_delta, confidence_pct.
sam: We already have /v1/estimate/route_quota — can we extend that rather than adding a new endpoint? Feels duplicative. eng-platform input?
lee: Extending existing endpoint makes sense, but saved views can include complex filter predicates that change token scaling (e.g., time-windowed slices). The payload must accept a filter_selectivity hint or sample query.
alex: Proposed minimal payload: {route_id, filters, model_ids[], lookback_days}. Response (UI-facing): tokens_est, cost_est, confidence_label (High/Medium/Low), notes.
maya: For backend, suggest precompute nightly aggregates to make UI responses cheap; for ad-hoc fresh windows fallback to sampled live calc (higher latency).
sam: Rollout plan: feature flag per-org with default off. For orgs without telemetry access show only bucketed ranges. Also add an audit log when someone views absolute estimates.
lee: +1 on audit log. Also flag that quantized variants (int8/4bit) change per-token cost drastically — include model_variant_hint in payload so estimator knows the exact billing profile.
ora: I'll take sampling tweaks. Also we should record the sample_window used for the estimate in telemetry so we can improve estimator over time.
alex: Nice — shipping checklist: UI mock + microcopy, API schema PR, backend precompute job, feature flag + rollout doc. I'll create a ticket and attach mockups.
sam: I'll draft the API schema and open PR tomorrow.
maya: I'll update console mocks and add confirmation copy for low-confidence cases.
lee: I'll add audit log entries to the plan.
ops-bot: Deploy reminder: add FF gates and a canary rollout to 10% of orgs first.
alex: Thanks all — will sync in the weekly console sync if anything blocks.
